setup: Hands on a bench or bar, a bit wide
Walk your feet back to a straight line
execution: Lower your chest to the edge
Elbows angled back, not straight out
Push the bench away to straight arms

notes: Use something that won't slide or tip: a fixed bench, a Smith bar locked in place, or a racked barbell.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at bench height, head on the left, hands on the edge of a flat bench. Whole body from head to heels in frame.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Hands on the bench edge slightly wider than the shoulders, arms straight. Body in a straight line from head to heels at roughly 30–45° to the floor.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Chest lowered to just above the bench edge. Elbows bent and angled back about 45° from the body. Body still straight.

emphasise: Straight line from head to heels
Chest, not chin, goes to the bench
